D.t: Dina Titus leads by 17.3 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 52,540 votes; a one point swing is about 1,520 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +9.0 and D +25.4. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$662K cash against $670K. Roughly even money; the air war will be decided by outside groups and earned media.
Registered Democrats cast 40% of the 532,650 ballots in Nevada so far, against 34% for the other party. That is 8.7 points better for Democrats than the forecast expected by now.

D.h: What the ballots so far say
D.t: The early vote has moved this forecast 1.7 points toward Dina Titus. Bank it: chase the remaining mail ballots and low propensity voters who have not voted.
